contents.text: Response times for customers with a service contract are measured from the time the call is logged to the time the engineer arrives on site. For P2 calls, response times are 1 business day.

SVC-POL-002: Response times for contracted customers
# SVC-POL-002: Response times for contracted customers
Field Services commits to these response times for customers with a service contract, measured from the time the call is logged:
| Priority | Definition | On-site response |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | Production stopped, or a safety risk | 4 hours |
| P2 | Production degraded | 1 business day |
| P3 | Planned or cosmetic work | 5 business days |
Escalate any P1 call that has no engineer assigned after 30 minutes to the Field Services duty manager.
Response times are measured from the time the call is logged to the time the engineer arrives on site.
Calls logged outside working hours count from 07:00 the next business day, except P1 calls, which count from the time they are logged.

VD-75 Variable Frequency Drive: Installation and Fault Guide › 4 Faults
|---|---|---|---|
| F002 | DC bus overvoltage | Ramp-down time too short for the load's inertia | Raise parameter 2-11 or fit a brake resistor |
| F008 | Fieldbus timeout | No message from the controller for 2 seconds | Check the network cable and the controller |
| F016 | Cooling fan failure | Fan blocked or worn out | Replace fan PN-7716-A |

Field service report SR-2026-1130
Date: November 30, 2026.
Complaint: the evaporator fan drive stopped several times a night with fault F002.
Findings: the ramp-down time had been set to 1 second after a controller upgrade, too short for the fan's inertia.
Work done: raised parameter 2-11 (ramp-down time) to 20 seconds.
No further F002 faults in 48 hours of logging.
